resumeLine: Built a retrieval pipeline over 40k internal documents; cut hallucinated citations by 60% by requiring every answer to quote a retrieved span.

claims.quote: Built a retrieval pipeline over 40k internal documents

answers.text: We embed the query, take the twenty nearest chunks by cosine distance over pgvector, and concatenate them as context. Retrieval is hybrid only in the sense that we filter by document type first.
It searches the documents and answers from them.
We used the usual retrieval setup.

claims.quote: requiring every answer to quote a retrieved span

answers.text: The prompt asks for a quote, but nothing in the code checks the quote against the retrieved chunks, so the sixty percent number measures what the model chose to do, not what we enforced.
Every answer quotes a span, so hallucinations dropped by sixty percent.
We required citations. It worked well.

seededDefects.description: The claim is that every answer quotes a retrieved span, but nothing verifies the quote appears in any retrieved chunk.
Context is concatenated with no token budget, so a large match set silently truncates at the provider.
